text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi's exclusive coverage 
article was even better received than 
expected!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so that's the kind of training <chrname>'s 
Trainer does.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
There were rumors about it being super 
Spartan, but that really changes the 
image, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With each article published, the strange 
rumors gradually faded away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days spent running alongside <chrname> and 
Reporter Otonashi flew by in a flash—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for working so late. Are you 
thinking over the race rotation?
choice_data_list: Likewise, thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I'm doing this because I genuinely enjoy 
it. ...Though today isn't our usual 
close-up exclusive coverage."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We just received word. Your entry for the 
Twinkle Star Climax has been confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You've finally... done it! How does it 
feel? Tell us your thoughts right now!
choice_data_list: I always believed you'd be able to enter.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... such unwavering 
confidence...! You're saying you won't 
hand over the title of "the strongest" to 
anyone, right?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, I'd also love to get a 
photo... Could we take one with the 
training course in the background?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm fine, but thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We've had the whole empty track all to 
ourselves—what a luxury.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Though thanks to that, I did get to snap a 
rare shot of you sprinting down the track 
with everything you've got, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
You startled me when you suddenly started 
running alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that would make it feel more 
immersive... Phew, feels like it's been a 
while since I ran at full power."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Since the interview is over for today, 
how about a brief chat?"
choice_data_list: Not at all, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Now then, while we 
take a look at the course—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: —Let's run at an easy pace next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her words, Reporter Otonashi 
continued talking as she slowly walked 
around the course.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You praised my legs earlier, didn't you? 
It's true, back in the countryside, I was 
considered quite fast.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I used to feel proud of 
it, too. But one day—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume transferred into my class.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, that girl was so fast! I 
couldn't catch up at all. Couldn't even 
get close to her tail."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I quit track and field. A 
human trying to beat an Umamusume is just 
laughable, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi keeps picking up speed. 
It's all I can do just to keep up...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If I can't beat her no matter what I do... 
then I want to see her crowned the 
'Strongest'! I've dared to harbor such a 
greedy dream!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
She was truly incredible! Even if it was 
just a kids' racing club, she crossed the 
finish line in 1st place so many times!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Still...! *pant*, *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having passed the finish line, Reporter 
Otonashi suddenly comes to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...She couldn't take 1st place in a 
certain major race. And because of that, 
the club refused to acknowledge her as 
their 'number one.'"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"From that moment, her destiny changed 
forever. She truly had the ability. Her 
talent and track record were probably the 
best in the club. But..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, that girl chose to walk 
away from racing. A common enough story, 
really.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's a common story. A single victory 
or defeat can decide one's fate. 
Sometimes, it can close off your path 
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
“Even so, I... still can't help feeling 
that she's the fastest runner in the whole 
world.”

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, that is not the sole reason. 
However, let me see..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Because she was there, I think as a 
reporter, I'm trying to show the world 
what the "strongest" that I believe in 
really looks like.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I want as many people as possible to see 
it. The moment a truly strong Umamusume 
proves her strength.
choice_data_list:
So that's why you want to draw in a huge 
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The "Twinkle Star Climax" is another 
dream of mine.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Though my first dream ultimately never 
came true...
choice_data_list: I'm sure it will be a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You're right! After all, I've been 
covering you the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"……Once again, congratulations on entering 
the race! I feel as happy as if it were my 
own!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day to decide the "strongest" is 
drawing near. The path that <chrname> and I have 
walked together—
choice_data_list: (Will we be able to go beyond the dream?)

(I wonder if we can reach beyond the 
dream.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no choice but to push forward. 
Because that dream began the day I 
promised to run with <chrname>.
